scope: Actual pinned free Yoast Article/public author/dates alongside the existing title/image/sitemap reference, compared with independently configured native structured author/image/headline. No premium execution, migration or universal schema parity.

native.difference: Owner-local identities and image alt per Open Graph guidance; native canonical editorial image index. Does not copy source plugin rules or assert premium/rendering equivalence.

structured.difference: Free Yoast derives author from public WordPress display_name and emits actual WordPress publication time and a modification time only after the real later published edit. Native author is a separately published explicit identity; original publication time is factual and no new modification date is invented. No premium location execution or complete provider feature equivalence.
